summary: Frontend-only regression + new features validation for KASKECIL, NRP, print PDF, attachments, and Accurate-format Jurnal Umum export. All acceptance criteria verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: PrintDoc opens a new window with document.write; popup blockers may prevent it. Acceptable for admin desktop but consider a fallback iframe print.
flatRows() Excel export uses .xls HTML mime — Excel shows security warning on opening; keep, or move to real xlsx (SheetJS) if strict.
DocumentForm.jsx (~280 LOC) still mixes KASKECIL/NRP branching via DOC_META flags; clean but growing — consider splitting when adding another doc type.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_KASKECIL Konsumsi and TEST_NRP Parkir docs during UI tests; both approved fully and journalized (balanced).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: sidebar nav-kaskecil & nav-nrp render; KASKECIL form hides manual DPP input (uses readonly total from items) and keeps form-ppn + form-pph; NRP form has no tax panel (form-ppn count=0); add-attachment/att-name-0 works; DocumentDetail shows Lampiran Bukti section and print-document button; approvals: KASKECIL=4 steps, NRP=2 steps; generate-journal produces balanced journals for both (8 balanced / 0 unbalanced total in Jurnal Umum after tests). Jurnal Umum CSV headers exactly: 'Tanggal,Nomor Bukti,Keterangan,Kode Akun,Nama Akun,Nilai Debit,Nilai Kredit,Departemen,Proyek,No Faktur Pajak' with dd/mm/yyyy date format (e.g., 24/09/2026); Excel export downloads jurnal-umum-accurate.xls. Print button clickable (window.print popup not explicitly asserted but code path executed without console errors). PP regression not re-run in this iteration but not touched by changes; iteration_1 already validated PP full workflow with DPP/PPN/PPh balanced journal.
rca of the issue: N/A - all features working as specified.
